already_verified_compression.equality_verified: Verifier decompresses complete stream and checks exact raw SHA/size; an independent read-only gzip stream calculation also matched retained compressed SHA/size.
already_verified_compression.safe_sequential_cleanup: After the final verification/equality check, remove only the explicit raw original; retain gzip, manifest, and restoration instructions. Update command evidence_paths to existing gzip and manifest. Do not delete broader directories.

generic_packager_constraints.audit_contract_requires: AUDIT.md with exactly one nonempty ## TASK_ID section per assigned target
generic_packager_constraints.checks_member_handling: Automatically bundles checks/ when projected return members exceed 256. --bundle-evidence is available explicitly. Bundling does not reduce counted expanded bytes.
generic_packager_constraints.command_record_rules: Relative cwd only; nonempty string argv array; all evidence_paths must exist as payload or bundled checks entries.
generic_packager_constraints.generated_fields: Builder creates artifact hashes, INTAKE.json, canonical RESULTS identity and source.patch; do not author INTAKE manually.
generic_packager_constraints.new_output_rule: Output ZIP must not already exist.
generic_packager_constraints.permitted_changes: Selected generator.py, notes.md, SUMMARY.md and workspace/tests/counterexamples; narrowly assigned canonical/base changes. Shared repo source modifications, deletions, binaries, renames, executables and symlinks are rejected.
generic_packager_constraints.replay_requirement: Apply exact final source.patch to fresh original packet WORK/ with isolated Git root; focused regressions; source SHA equality; retain exact commands and receipts; final solve source SHA must equal final generator bytes.
generic_packager_constraints.replay_status: No final patch replay performed by this inventory task.

optional_additional_compression.note: Gzip estimates generated into an in-memory counting/hash sink only; no compressed files written or originals altered. Compression must be source-verified again during sequential final cleanup.
optional_additional_compression.purpose: Retain both full censuses and all intermediate after failures with comfortable byte headroom.

recommended_final_sequence: Finish active visible-only solve and preserve genuine attempt records.
Assemble required reports and both audit sections; fill honest RESULTS command records.
Sequentially verify retained gzip equality immediately before explicitly removing raw original; optionally compress both censuses and intermediate override report with full byte preservation.
Update all command evidence_paths referencing removed raw files to retained streams/manifests and include restoration instructions.
Build an interim ZIP outside checks; replay its exact patch in fresh WORK with isolated Git root and focused tests.
Record fresh replay, build final ZIP, compare final patch SHA with replayed patch, validate final identity/source/solve hashes, and return only final ZIP.
